description: A Purchase Executive - Construction Material is a key professional in the construction industry responsible for learning and applying procurement practices to ensure that materials are sourced efficiently and cost effectively. Learners in this role gain hands-on experience in vendor management, inventory control, and quality assurance. They develop skills in identifying reliable suppliers, comparing prices, and ensuring the timely delivery of construction materials to meet project timelines. By understanding the complete procurement process, learners contribute to smooth project execution while staying within budget and maintaining quality standards.
awardingBodyName: The Institution of Civil Engineers Society
typeOfQualification: General, Fresh Skilling, Upskilling, For ToT, For ToA

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Maintain Health and Safety in Procurement Activities
Assist Production and Workflow: Related to Material Availability
Perform Inventory Control, Receiving and Tracking Operations
Carry Out Material Sourcing and Procurement Activities
